title: Schnitzel With German Bitter Greens
description: A classic German dish featuring crispy breaded cutlet served with a side of bitter greens.

ingredients.name: sauerbraten greens
ingredients.notes: such as kale or collard greens

instructions: Season the cutlet with salt and pepper.
Dredge the cutlet in flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the cutlet in beaten eggs, coating completely.
Roll the cutlet in breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the breaded cutlet and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
Transfer the cutlet to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
In the same skillet, add the sauerbraten greens and cook until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Serve the schnitzel with the sauerbraten greens on the side.
